Revenue and Receivables: Revenue recognition, sales, deferred or contract revenue, receivables, collectibility, or related balances and controls.
Long-Lived and Intangible Assets: Goodwill, intangible or long-lived assets, property and equipment, leases, impairment, depreciation, amortization, software, real estate, or asset-retirement obligations.
Inventory and Cost of Sales: Inventory existence or valuation, costing, reserves, work in progress, and cost of sales.
Business Combinations and Consolidation: Acquisitions, business combinations, purchase accounting, consolidation, variable interests, divestitures, or discontinued operations.
Reporting, Controls, Estimates and Audit: Cross-cutting financial reporting, controls, estimates, valuations, disclosures, journal entries, fraud, materiality, planning, or audit procedures when no more specific account class dominates.
Credit, Loans, Deposits and Insurance: Loans, credit losses, deposits, insurance or reinsurance, premiums, claims, and related reserves or allowances.
Investments and Financial Instruments: Investments, securities, derivatives, financial instruments, foreign currency, partnership interests, or digital assets.
Debt, Equity and Liabilities: Debt, equity, warrants, payables, accruals, other liabilities, contingencies, litigation, or capital transactions.
Cash and Other Assets: Cash or assets not defensibly covered by a more specific supplied class.
Related Parties and Significant Transact: Related-party matters or significant, unusual, or certain transactions as the principal topic.
Expenses, Compensation and Benefits: Expenses, payroll, stock compensation, pensions, post-retirement benefits, commissions, or employee benefit obligations.
Income Taxes: Current or deferred income taxes, tax provisions, uncertain tax positions, or related controls and valuation allowances.
